subject: Onsite travel safety playbook (contingency & advisories) - Acme Health Systems workshop
messages: From: Alison Park To: Marissa Cole Cc: Global Travel Desk , Tom Reynolds Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Onsite workshop logistics — health & safety guidance request Hi Marissa, Thanks again — we're excited to host the Redwood team for the two-day technical workshop on 27-28 Mar. Our travel desk flagged a regional weather advisory and a recent minor security incident near the venue. Before we finalize delivery logistics, could you share Redwood's standard health & safety guidance and contingency procedures for on-site exec workshops? Specifically we need: - A one-page summary we can circulate to attendees (travel behavior, emergency contacts, mask/PPE guidance) - Contingency options if an advisory escalates (virtual backup, refund/credit policy, travel rebooking support) - Evidence of visitor screening/NDAs or a template we can sign I've attached our internal visitor policy for your reference. Please cc our travel desk on any vendor contacts. Appreciate a short turnaround — can you get back to us by EOD tomorrow? Best, Alison Park Program Manager — Events Acme Health Systems [attachment: Acme_visitor_policy.pdf (PDF, 92KB)] From: Marissa Cole To: Alison Park Cc: Rishi Malhotra , Aisha Rahman , Global Travel Desk Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:43:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Onsite workshop logistics — health & safety guidance request Alison — thanks for the heads up and for the visitor policy. Attached is a working draft of Redwood's travel & onsite safety playbook (Travel_Checklist_Redwood_v1.pdf) and our live risk register (Onsite_Risk_Register.xlsx). High level commitments: - One-pager: included at top of the PDF — short behavioral guidance, Redwood emergency contact (24/7 on-call) and local emergency numbers. - Contingency options: we can switch to a remote-only delivery within 4 hours if local authorities advise against gatherings. We also maintain a travel rebooking buffer (2x seats on standby) via our vendor for execs; Rishi below will coordinate names and flight classes. - Visitor screening/NDAs: we can use Acme's policy, but prefer a short NDAs DocuSign — link in the shared drive. Requests / next steps: - Rishi: please confirm vendor availability for standby rebookings and whether our travel vendor can proactively change itineraries at no penalty under advisories. - Aisha: own the on-site medical contact and PPE kit distribution; add one local clinic contact to the risk register. - Alison/Tom: confirm final attendee list by Fri 3/19 so we can lock travel and DocuSign. I'll hold a quick 20-min call tomorrow at 10:30am PT to walk through the checklist if that works for you. Marissa Cole Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123 [attachment: Travel_Checklist_Redwood_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)] Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xy_example_playbook From: Rishi Malhotra To: Marissa Cole , Alison Park Cc: Global Travel Desk Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:29:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Onsite workshop logistics — vendor standby & travel notes Looping in a quick vendor update: I spoke to Pacific Travel Partners (PTP) this morning. Key points: - They can provide standby rebooking for up to 3 execs per booking class at no additional fee if the advisory is issued within 48 hours of departure. Need names and ticket numbers to place on hold. - They recommended blocking refundable hotel rates for the core execs and using flexible rate policies for attendees. - Vaccination/health screening: PTP said they can add a pre-travel health questionnaire and share it with the travel desk; it's optional but recommended. Action items from me: I will prepare a short traveler info form and sample flight hold instructions by EOD today and will upload to the shared drive. If anyone expects to travel international, flag now — different rules. Thanks, Rishi Account Executive | Redwood Inference rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com [attachment: Itinerary_stub_PTP.txt (TXT, 1KB)] From: Vivek Kulkarni To: Marissa Cole , Rishi Malhotra Cc: Aisha Rahman , Alison Park Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Onsite workshop logistics — travel safety playbook Appreciate the quick response team. A few leadership asks: - Please publish the one-page attendee brief and emergency escalation steps to the Acme contact list and our on-call Slack #exec-travel channel. - If an incident (anything requiring local law enforcement or public health intervention) occurs, notify me and CS immediately and pause any billing-related activities pending a safety review. - Share Redwood's 24/7 emergency mobile number in the one-pager. Aisha — loop me in once you've confirmed the on-site medical resource and PPE kit logistics. I want the contingency to be operationally exercised (who calls who) before the first travel day. -Vivek Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199 From: Marissa Cole To: Alison Park , Tom Reynolds Cc: Rishi Malhotra , Aisha Rahman , Vivek Kulkarni , Global Travel Desk Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 16:48:00 -07:00 Subject: Final: One-pager + contingency checklist for 27-28 Mar workshop Alison / Tom — attaching the finalized one-pager and the updated risk register. Highlights: - Emergency contacts: Redwood on-call + local clinic + Acme security desk (listed in the PDF). - Contingency flows: 1) Advisory before travel: Travel desk cancels/refunds when applicable; we offer remote workshop (same agenda) with 4-hour notice. 2) Advisory during travel or onsite: Redwood executes evacuation checklist; affected attendees moved to safe location; we shift to remote delivery for remainder of day. 3) Post-incident: incident report + retrospective within 48 hours. - Travel contingencies: PTP standby holds for up to 3 execs; refundable hotel rates recommended for 5 core attendees. Next steps for Acme: please confirm final attendee list and sign the short NDA via this DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/agree/example_acme_ndas I've uploaded the final assets here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xy_example_playbook Attachments: Travel_Checklist_Redwood_v1.pdf, Onsite_Risk_Register.xlsx See you on the call Monday at 10:30am PT if needed. Thanks, Marissa Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123 [attachment: Travel_Checklist_Redwood_v1.pdf (PDF, 52KB)] [attachment: Onsite_Risk_Register.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]
